description: List a product (digital or physical) in your store: title, price, brand, category, description, inventory, media links, delivery details, and an optional affiliate (zeno) percentage. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

brand.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

category.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

delivery_info.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

description.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

digital_file_url.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

inventory.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

more_info_link.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

photo_or_youtube_link1.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

photo_or_youtube_link2.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

photo_or_youtube_link3.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

price.description: Amount in GEODE as a decimal string (e.g. "1.25"), or {"raw": "<planck>"}

product_location.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

title.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

zeno_percent.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

name: geode_market_add_a_product
title: Market: add a product
